sourceText:
Jamie's Southwest Soup
By: sybaker
Published: Tuesday, February 23, 2010 - 10:07pm

Ingredients




1/2 large white onion
1 15 oz can pinto beans
1 15 oz can black beans
2 11.5 oz cans white shoepeg corn
2 15 oz cans diced tomatoes
3 cups water
2 packets taco seasoning
2 packets dry ranch dressing
1 pound ground turkey
salt and pepper

Preparation

1 Dice onion into 1 inch pieces and place in a stock pot. 2 Rinse beans, corn, and tomatoes and place in pot. 3 Add water and cook over medium heat. 4 Stir in taco seasoning and ranch. 5 Brown turkey and drain before placing in pot. 6 Add salt and pepper to taste. 7 Cover and reduce heat to low and allow to simmer for 15 minutes. 8 Enjoy topped with sour cream, ranch dressing, cheese, and/or tortilla chips.
